record.required_action: Policyholder may appeal the partial settlement decision

conventions.evidence: issuer, issue_date, deadline and every amount survive only with a snippet that exists, is not blank, and contains the value it is evidence for. Anything else is nulled and listed in missing_evidence, and the record is flagged REQUIRES_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION. A field the letter never mentioned is null with no snippet and no flag: absent is an answer, unquotable is not
conventions.verbatim_limit: verbatim cannot be verified here. There is no document text to diff a snippet against, only an image the model already looked at, so this checks that the extracted value appears in the text quoted for it. That catches a number quoted against text saying a different number. It does not catch a snippet invented whole, and no check available here would
conventions.identity: content_hash covers every page's bytes in the order given, so the same scan under a new filename is the same letter and a re-ordered pair of pages is not. The id is derived from that hash and from nothing else
conventions.idempotency: a content_hash already present in the records directory is a no-op: nothing is written and the existing record stands. Re-extracting costs another vision call and produces a second record that competes with the first rather than correcting it
conventions.splitting: which pages form one letter is the model's call, and the bias is toward splitting. A duplicate record costs an annoying second notification; a false merge silently eats a deadline
conventions.handoff: nothing here is answered, submitted, paid or filed with anyone. This writes one JSON file into the directory it was given, and the letter itself is still a person's to act on

summary: Filed 1 page as letter-cf7a35500ef237c1, an insurance letter. Quotable and kept: issuer, issue_date, amounts. Nothing has been answered, submitted or filed with anyone.
